Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unable to accept supplier invite - SSO mapping failing

Hi Priyom,

We received the Redwood supplier invite this morning but when I click Accept it redirects to our IdP and then immediately shows a 403 / ‘alias not recognized’ page. Our IAM team says their logs show a mismatched LDAP attribute for our externalEmail attribute. Can you confirm what attribute Redwood is expecting for the accept flow? We need to get this vendor account accepted today so we can process the PO for Q2.

Attaching a screenshot of the 403.

Thanks,

Date: 2028-04-01T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unable to accept supplier invite - SSO mapping failing

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot.

Short answer: our invite accept uses the SAML NameID or the external_email LDAP attribute (depending on whether the customer IdP sends an email as NameID). If the IdP is sending a different attribute name (e.g. mailAlternateAddress) the portal will not match and you'll see a 403.

I'm looping in Ben (SAML/SSO ops) and Kim (onboarding) to pull the IdP assertion and confirm what your IdP is sending. Ben — can you grab the assertion for the accept hit around 2028-04-01T09:10 PDT and confirm which attribute is mapped as NameID? If we need to apply an alias mapping on our side we can, or we can advise SapphireForge to map their attribute to match.

I'll keep you updated.

Best,
Priyom Das
SaaS Onboarding | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood-inference.com

On Tue, Apr 1, 2028 at 9:45 AM priyom.das@redwood-inference.com wrote:
> Ben — can you grab the assertion for the accept hit around 2028-04-01T09:10 PDT and confirm which attribute is mapped as NameID?

I pulled the logs. The assertion shows NameID = urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3 (uid) and the attribute list includes mail and mailAlternateAddress. Our accept flow currently prefers NameID, and if NameID is not an email we fall back to attribute 'mail'. In this case NameID is a uid (sforge-admin) and mail exists as user@sf.internal which doesn't match the external invite email alyssa.chen@sapphireforge.com.

Options: 
- Quickest (we can do in ~30 mins): apply an alias mapping on the tenant that maps that uid to the invite email for this single invite (one-off fix).
- Recommended: ask SapphireForge IAM to add email as NameID or ensure the 'mail' attribute equals the invite address.
- Safe workaround: we can manually accept the vendor account on our side and link it to the invite (audit log will note manual acceptance).

I'm attaching the relevant IdP assertion extract.

Ben
Ben Carter
SAML/Identity Ops | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Unable to accept supplier invite - SSO mapping failing

Alyssa / SapphireForge IT —

Ben confirms the NameID is a non-email uid and mail does not match the invite address. We can do a one-off alias mapping and manually accept the vendor account so you can move forward with the PO. I propose:

1) We apply an alias mapping for this tenant that maps NameID 'sforge-admin' to alyssa.chen@sapphireforge.com and accept the invite (audit captured).
2) After acceptance, SapphireForge IAM should update their IdP to send email as NameID or make 'mail' equal the invite address to avoid recurrence.

If you approve the one-off fix I will proceed and share the audit entry. If you prefer your IAM to change the mapping, we can hold off and I can provide steps.

Quick question for your IAM: will a NameID change be disruptive to internal SSO for other apps? If so, manual acceptance may be preferable for this vendor invite only.

Thanks,
Priyom
